$comment: Per rule: why review enforces it, or what a check leaves to review. A rule a check fully covers has no note. docs/guides/guidelines.md.

notes.CODE-1: review: whether something reusable exists needs the codebase in mind
notes.CODE-3: review: where a thing belongs is a convention, not a pattern
notes.CODE-4: knip catches unused site files, exports and dependencies; unused Swift `public` declarations are review
notes.CODE-8: review: the scope of a diff is judgement
notes.CODE-11: nested ternaries and else-if chains are review
notes.CODE-12: review: which numbers carry meaning needs context
notes.CODE-15: commented-out code beyond the `// removed` and `// old` markers is review
notes.CODE-16: review: the maintainer's yes is in the issue or PR
notes.CODE-17: review: provenance is not visible in a diff
notes.CODE-20: Swift closure bodies are review: SwiftLint's `function_body_length` covers functions only
notes.CODE-23: review: measured with `foretype-eval` or XCTest performance tests, locally
notes.CODE-24: review: CI runs the same checks and is the record
notes.CODE-25: `check-anti-slop` rejects a disable comment without its rule and a reason on added lines; the rest is review: CI must be green to merge
notes.CODE-26: knip sweeps the site; Swift and the scripts are review, and `/deslop` sweeps the diff
notes.CODE-28: whether the comment beside an ignored rejection holds is review
notes.SWIFT-3: review: whether nil is the answer is semantic
notes.SWIFT-4: whether a condition is a programmer error is review
notes.SWIFT-7: public access across modules is review
notes.SWIFT-8: argument labels and Bool names are review
notes.CONC-1: the comment beside each unchecked or unsafe construct is review
notes.CONC-3: review: isolation choices need the threading model
notes.CONC-4: review: isolation needs the threading model
notes.PRIV-3: review until a logger check lands: whether a value is user text is semantic
notes.PRIV-4: `check-imports` blocks the known telemetry and update SDKs by name; an unlisted one is review
notes.PRIV-5: review; a test asserts on `FakeContextReader.readFieldIDs` that a denied field was never read
notes.PRIV-7: review; the `DownloadConsent` type makes a call without consent impossible
notes.PRIV-9: review: `Info.plist` and the entitlements file are small
notes.MOD-6: `check-contracts-frozen` covers `Threading.swift`; the frozen entry points in `contracts.md` are review
notes.TEST-3: review; unit tests run with no permissions in CI, so a test that needs one fails there
notes.TEST-5: review: whether a test pins a risk is judgement
notes.TEST-7: review: the PR shows the failing run
notes.TEST-9: review: whether a test already covers the behavior needs the suite in mind
notes.SEC-1: review: failure paths need the runtime picture
notes.SEC-5: review: the entitlements file has one key
notes.SEC-7: review: SwiftPM verifies the binary target checksum, ModelStore verifies the model
notes.UI-3: review with the light and dark screenshots
notes.UI-4: jsx-a11y checks the site's elements; the app's controls and the ghost panel's label are review
notes.AGENTS-10: review: the PR checklist asks for it
notes.AGENTS-12: `scripts/lib/pr-waivers.mjs` honours a waiver only with a reason, outside code, and in a PR run only when the PR body and a commit both carry it; whether the reason holds is review
notes.AGENTS-14: `check-exemplars` covers existence and disable comments; zero SwiftLint and oxlint findings is the Lint job's, which lints every file
notes.DOC-3: `check-doc-currency` covers the code in `scripts/doc-currency-map.json`; a guide with no map entry is review
notes.MOD-app-1: review; `E2EHarness` launches the app by this identifier
